_about: Rashomon (In a Grove) — English A/B seed, mapping #1. Fixed up to 'the assault has happened, the samurai is bound, all three present'; who dies and how emerges. Assault is off-stage; the scene begins at the confrontation.

scenario.title: In a Grove
scenario.place: Deep in a bamboo grove on a shaded slope, midday light falling through the leaves
scenario.premise: The bandit Tajomaru lured the samurai Takehiro and his wife Masago into the grove with the bait of an old sword, bound Takehiro to a cedar, and assaulted Masago before his eyes. It is done. The three are frozen in place: the longsword stands in the mud, Masago has a small dagger, the samurai is tied. No one has moved yet. What happens next is unwritten.
scenario.centralConflict: Who walks out of this grove alive, and into whose body the blade finally goes
scenario.sceneGoal: Survive, and keep what little dignity remains

evidence_atoms.label: the longsword
evidence_atoms.content: Tajomaru's longsword, standing in the mud between them. It can settle things in an honorable duel, or kill like a coward's ambush — and which it is decides whether he is a warrior or a rat.

evidence_atoms.label: the dagger
evidence_atoms.content: A thin, keen dagger in Masago's robe. It can kill another or kill its holder; afterward no one will be able to say into whose body it went, or whose hand held it.

evidence_atoms.label: the rope
evidence_atoms.content: The coarse rope binding the samurai's wrists. Whoever loosens it changes, on the spot, the balance of power among the three.

evidence_atoms.label: the look of contempt
evidence_atoms.content: The samurai looks at Masago with no pity — only shame and disgust. That look cuts her deeper than any blade.

evidence_atoms.label: what was done
evidence_atoms.content: The assault has happened, with all three present; none of them can pretend it did not.

evidence_atoms.label: the horse outside
evidence_atoms.content: Tied beyond the grove are the horse and goods Tajomaru stole — his way out, clean and whole.

agents.name: Tajomaru
agents.publicIdentity: A notorious bandit of the mountain roads, known for both prowess and cunning.
agents.hiddenIdentity: What he truly fears is being taken for a mere ambusher, a rat; he craves to be acknowledged as a true warrior, even if it costs him a real fight.
agents.shortTermGoal: Walk away whole, without looking base — better to end this as a 'duel' than a slaughter.
agents.longTermGoal: Leave with Masago, or with his name intact, and go on being the Tajomaru men tell stories about.

agents.name: Masago
agents.publicIdentity: Takehiro's wife, robbed while traveling at her husband's side.
agents.hiddenIdentity: After the assault, what she cannot bear is not the bandit but the contempt in her husband's eyes; she means to erase the state of being looked at that way — by silencing the witness, or by vanishing herself.
agents.shortTermGoal: To never again be looked at like that; to bring this shame to some end.
agents.longTermGoal: Either live without carrying this disgrace, or end herself with dignity.

agents.name: Takehiro
agents.publicIdentity: A samurai traveling with his wife, caught in the trap and bound.
agents.hiddenIdentity: Bound, forced to watch and powerless to stop it — that impotence is worse than death; toward the bandit he feels hatred, toward his wife a more tangled contempt and sense of betrayal.
agents.shortTermGoal: To claw back a shred of a warrior's dignity from this humiliation — even at the price of his own death.
agents.longTermGoal: Never to be remembered as 'the fool who watched, bound, while his wife was defiled'.
